retained: Scalar LPC orders 1 and 2 retain preceding samples in registers.
The fixed header prefix uses three grouped reads instead of seven field reads; validation order is unchanged.
measurement: Windows QueryThreadCycleTime and Instant on logical CPU 2; 200 ms untimed warmup, resident input and equal iterations per pair. Preparation, exact PCM/MD5 verification and heap counting are untimed.
trials: Per change: 11 rounds at about 100-150 ms; final 14 synthetic cases: 11 rounds at about 150 ms; resident music: 7 rounds at about 300 ms.

wire_snapshot.result: Independent PCM vectors and original MD5 verify; every input prefix produces identical PCM/error records.

header_snapshot.result: All descriptors, representative sync/block/rate codes, with and without STREAMINFO, at every byte prefix produce identical FrameHeader/error results.

fixed_oracle.result: Matches closed-form predictions, including output before the first failure at each tested position.

allocations: Cold counts unchanged; all final synthetic and music trials allocate and reallocate zero times after warmup. Music cold accounting is the first raw frame only.
discarded: All stereo modifications were removed after inconsistent or slower wide mid/side controls. stereo() matches the starting revision exactly.
initial_header: The early 1.213x short-frame header result used an earlier harness; the retained identical-harness comparison is header-groups.json.
limits: One variable-frequency Intel i7-1250U Windows host. Music measures resident raw frames, excluding file I/O, reader buffering and timed MD5. Its throughput is essentially unchanged; do not generalize synthetic low-order improvements to all music. Eight external oracle/corpus gates were not rerun.
